name: showroom-manager-billing
description: Showroom Manager — MyBillBook style GST billing & inventory app (offline PWA)

scripts.smoke: node smoke/preflight.mjs && esbuild smoke/run.tsx --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --loader:.tsx=tsx --external:jsdom --outfile=smoke/.build/run.mjs --log-level=error && node smoke/.build/run.mjs
scripts.build:docs: npm run build && npm run build:single && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const out=path.join('..','docs');fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist',out,{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('showroom-manager-app.html',path.join(out,'showroom-manager-app.html'));fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out,'.nojekyll'),'');console.log('docs/ ready (GitHub Pages branch-source + jsDelivr/githack ke liye)')"
scripts.build:android: npm run build && npm run build:single && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');const out=path.join('..','app','src','main','assets','webapp');fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('dist',out,{recursive:true});fs.rmSync(path.join(out,'.nojekyll'),{force:true});fs.copyFileSync('showroom-manager-app.html',path.join(out,'showroom-manager-app.html'));console.log('Android assets ready:', out)"
